main_text.head: Homo, dum per glaciem inambulat, illa diffiliente periens. XXXXII.
main_text.p: A Dstriĕti glacie niti qui fluminis audet, Haud raro glacie dissiliente perit. Hoc sapite exemplo istius quos commoda vita Innumeris fallunt lubrica cuncta modis.

page.notes: The running head reads "EMBLEMATA." with the initial letter as a decorative capital. The heading numeral is printed "XXXXII" in the scan's motto line as "XXXIII"; it appears as "XXXXII" in the scan, copied as printed on reading: the number is written XXXII in the heading line, marked for checking. The central panel is an empty woodcut frame. The initial A of the verse is a large decorative letter. The verse lines contain long s printed as s in the original italic; normalised to s.
